from numpy import array
from PyQt5.uic import loadUi
from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMessageBox, QTableWidgetItem

def occurance(ch,t,n):
    nb=0
    for i in range(n) : 
        if t[i]["num"]==ch:
            nb+=1
    return nb 

def verif_alpha(ch):
    i = 0
    while i < len(ch) and (ch[i].upper() in ["A", "Z"] ):
        i += 1
    return i == len(ch)


def verif():
    ok=True
    if len(win.insc.text())!=6 or (occurance(win.insc.text(),t,n)!=1 and win.insc.text().isdigit()==False):
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur de saisie", "num insc invalide")
        ok = False
        
    elif len(win.np.text())>=40 or verif_alpha(win.np.text())==False or win.np.text()==""  :
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur de saisie", "nom prenom invalide")
        ok = False
        
    elif win.mg.text().isdigit()==False :
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur de saisie", "moy gen invalide")
        ok = False
         
    elif win.ir.isChecked()==False and win.ino.isChecked()==False :
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur de saisie", " i invalide")
        ok = False
        
    elif win.bn.currentIndex()==0 :
        QMessageBox.critical(win, "erreur de saisie", "bonification invalide")
        ok = False
        
    return ok 

def ajout():
    global n
    if verif():
        t[n] = {}
        t[n]["num"]=win.insc.text()
        t[n]["np"]=win.np.text()
        t[n]["mg"]=win.mg.text()
        t[n]["fs"]=win.fs.text()
        t[n]["bn"]=win.bn.currentText()
        if win.ir.isChecked()== True :
            t[n]["i"]="1.00"
        else:
            t[n]["i"]="1.05"
        t[n]["fg"]=(5*(float(t[n]["mg"])+(float(t[n]["fs"])))*(float(t[n]["i"])))+(int(t[n]["bn"]))
        #print(t[n])
        n+=1
        j=0
        win.table.setRowCount(0)
        for i in range(n):
            win.table.insertRow(j)
            win.table.setItem(j,0,QTableWidgetItem(t[i]["num"]))
            win.table.setItem(j,1,QTableWidgetItem(t[i]["np"]))
            win.table.setItem(j,2,QTableWidgetItem(t[i]["mg"]))
            win.table.setItem(j,3,QTableWidgetItem(t[i]["fs"]))
            win.table.setItem(j,4,QTableWidgetItem(t[i]["i"]))
            win.table.setItem(j,5,QTableWidgetItem(t[i]["bn"]))
            win.table.setItem(j,6,QTableWidgetItem(str(t[i]["fg"])))
            j+=1
            
def tri():
    echange=True
    while echange:
        echange=False
        for i in range(n-1):
            if t[i]["fg"]<t[i+1]["fg"]:
                t[i],t[i+1]=t[i+1],t[i]
                echange=True
                print(t[i])
